description: Settings for one nexus-cleanup run, keyed by flag name. Flags override the file; --execute is never a file setting.

$schema.description: Address of this schema, for editors. Read and ignored by the tool.

execute.description: Deletion is requested only by the --execute flag, never by a configuration file.

fail-on-skip.description: Exit non-zero if any group was skipped.

format.description: Report format: json or csv (default json).

from-path.description: Regex with (?P<name>...) and (?P<version>...) groups: retain by path.

keep.description: Newest versions to retain per group (default 1).

max-deletion-share.description: Abort above this share of enumerated components (0 = off).

max-deletions.description: Abort an executing run above this many deletions (0 = off).

password.description: Credentials never belong in a configuration file; set NEXUS_PASSWORD or pass --password.

pattern.description: Select proxy repositories by glob instead of by name.

repositories.description: Proxy repositories to clean, by name.

scope-from-path.description: Regex with a (?P<scope>...) group naming the scope within the asset path.

summary-out.description: Also write the aggregate here as JSON, relative to the working directory.

url.description: Nexus base URL; NEXUS_URL and --url override it. Never with credentials in it.

username.description: Nexus username; NEXUS_USERNAME and --username override it.

version-scheme.description: Force a version scheme instead of the per-format default.

title: nexus-cleanup configuration
